translation_snapshot.source:
Unleash your subconscious on the world around you.  While active, you fire up to %d bolts each turn (one per hostile target) that deal %0.2f mind damage.  Each bolt consumes 5 Feedback.
		Feedback gains beyond your maximum allowed amount may generate extra bolts (one bolt per %d excess Feedback per target), but no more than %d extra bolts per turn. 
		This effect is a psionic channel, increasing the range of Mind Sear, Psychic Lobotomy, and Sunder Mind to 10 but will break if you move.
		The damage will scale with your Mindpower.
translation_snapshot.target:
将你的潜意识释放到周围的世界。当此技能激活时，每回合你最多射出 %d 枚心灵飞弹（每个敌方目标一枚），造成 %0.2f 精神伤害。每枚飞弹消耗 5 点反馈值。
		当获得的反馈值超出最大值时，每超出 %d 点反馈值可能产生 1 枚额外飞弹；这些额外飞弹会再分配给敌方目标，每个目标至多 1 枚，且每回合总数不超过 %d 枚。
		此效果是一种灵能通道，可将心灵灼烧、心灵脑叶切除和碾碎心灵的射程提升至 10，但你一旦移动便会中断。
		受精神强度影响，伤害按比例加成。

translation_snapshot.source:
Sing a song of decay and defiance and sustain yourself through spite.
							Each time you suffer a detrimental effect, you gain a shield with strength %d, that lasts as long as the effect would.  This will add to and extend an existing shield if possible.
							This can only trigger once every %d turns
translation_snapshot.target:
唱响腐朽与抗争之歌，以怨恨支撑自身。
							每次你受到非自身施加、且不属于“其他”类型的负面状态时，你获得强度为 %d 的护盾，持续时间与该状态相同。如果可能，此效果会叠加到已有护盾并延长其持续时间。
							这一效果每 %d 回合只能触发一次。
